subtitle.zh: 由 Rspack 驱动的测试框架

slogan.en: Fast, build-integrated testing for JavaScript and TypeScript
slogan.zh: 为 JavaScript 和 TypeScript 项目带来快速、与构建深度集成的测试体验

reuseBuildConfigDesc.en: Use existing Rsbuild or Rspack config so aliases, transforms, and plugins stay consistent in tests.
reuseBuildConfigDesc.zh: 直接使用 Rsbuild 或 Rspack 配置，让 alias、transform 和插件能力在测试中保持一致。

productionAccurateTestingDesc.en: Powered by Rspack and Rsbuild for fast test compilation and a rich plugin ecosystem
productionAccurateTestingDesc.zh: 基于 Rspack 和 Rsbuild，为测试带来极快的编译速度和丰富的插件生态

realBrowserTestingDesc.en: Run tests in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit via Playwright, covering what a simulated DOM can't
realBrowserTestingDesc.zh: 基于 Playwright 在 Chromium、Firefox 和 WebKit 中运行测试，覆盖模拟 DOM 难以验证的场景
